description: Περιοχές που έχουν πληγεί απο τσουνάμι (Υδρογραφικά Δεδομένα) is a dataset listed in National Open Data Portal Cyprus, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Κτηματολογίου και Χωρομετρίας. Tsunami-affected areas (Hydrographic Data). Coverage: Τμήμα Κτηματολογίου και Χωρομετρίας. The portal shows the English title as "Tsunami-affected areas (Hydrographic Data)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Κτηματολογίου και Χωρομετρίας. Its keywords include γεωλογία, hydrography, γεωχωρικά. The listing shows 2024-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-national-open-data-portal-cyprus.
